name: gentlerain-ai-gc-main
description: This project is a pixel-perfect clone of [Gentlerain.ai](https://gentlerain.ai), a visually stunning and user-centric website that earned recognition on Awwwards for its design excellence. The goal of this project is to recreate the aesthetic, functionality, and interactivity of the original site, serving as a learning exercise in advanced web development and design principles.
